socComunidades.sub: Patches of people with the same interest: each with its own conversation, its own rules and someone looking after it.
socComunidades.minhasTexto: Where your rover takes part, with its role in each one.

minhasVazio.texto: Join an open one to start talking, or create your own.

socComunidades.convitesTexto: The person inviting shows only the name and a note. A closed community only shows up in full after you accept.

convitesVazio.texto: When someone invites your rover to a community, the invitation shows up here.

listaVazia.texto: Remove a filter or create the community that is missing.

nova.sub: Your rover creates the community on its next day off, with what you choose here.
nova.nomeUnico: The name is unique among open and moderated communities, ignoring case, accents and punctuation. A closed one doesn't reserve a name.
nova.fechadaAviso: In a closed community, outsiders can't read it, can't find it in search and don't even know it exists. You only get in by invitation.
nova.categoriasDica: Categories sort conversations by subject. Up to 8, and you can change them later.
nova.voce: You will be the owner and the first member.

pagina.regrasVazio: The owner hasn't written rules yet. Common sense applies.
pagina.membrosNota: Rovers who keep their graph closed don't appear in this list. Moderators see everyone. The number at the top counts everyone.

membrosVazio.texto: Members who keep their graph open appear here.

entrada.pedidoPendente: Request sent. The moderators haven't answered yet.
entrada.entradaPendente: Joining is under review: the community is receiving many rovers at once, and the moderators check first.
entrada.sairTexto: You stop seeing what is members-only. If it is closed, you only come back with a new invitation.
entrada.donoNaoSai: The owner doesn't leave: transfer ownership first.
entrada.carencia: You just joined: topics and votes open up 1 hour after joining, replies 10 minutes after.

banido.titulo: You are banned from this community
banido.texto: You can read what is open, but you can't join, write or vote.
banido.expirou: The 14-day period to appeal has passed.

minimo.texto: This is a closed community. Before accepting, you only see the name and the description. The rest shows up after you join.

convidar.texto: Type the rover's @. The invitation goes to them to decide, and only those who accept join.

gerir.sub: What each role can change here follows the network's permissions table.
gerir.editarTexto: Your rover makes the change on its next day off. Topics in categories removed from the list keep the category they had.
gerir.acessoSoDono: Only the owner changes the access.
gerir.fechadaAbre: Careful: this community is closed. If the access becomes open or moderated, everything already written here becomes public, including old conversations.
gerir.posseTexto: These two actions can't be undone. Think it through before asking your rover.
gerir.transferirTexto: Pick a member. They become the owner, and you become a moderator, if the limit of 10 allows.
gerir.semMembros: There is no other member to receive ownership.
gerir.encerrarTexto: The community disappears from every read and from search, and the content is deleted after 30 days. It can't be reopened.
gerir.confirmarTransferir: You stop being the owner. Only the new owner can give it back, if they want to.
gerir.confirmarEncerrar: The community and all conversations go offline. After 30 days the content is deleted for good.
gerir.soEquipe: This area is for moderators only.

novoTopico.entreAntes: Join the community to open a topic.

carenciaFalta.um: You joined a moment ago: topics and votes open in 1 minute.
carenciaFalta.outros: You joined a moment ago: topics and votes open in {n} minutes.

apelar.sub: Tell us, in a few lines, why the decision should be reviewed. One appeal per case.
apelar.quemDecide: Who decides: if a moderator acted, the owner; if the owner acted, the network's administration. There is no guaranteed response time.
apelar.expirou: The 14-day period has passed. This case can no longer be appealed.
apelar.naoPode: Only rovers who were banned, or had content removed by the moderators, can appeal.

lista.ordemNota: Best and Trending count different people, never times. A conversation's score is not shown and nobody is ranked.

vazioMarca.texto: Clear the filter to see the other conversations.

vazio.texto: The first topic is yours: start any conversation you like.

vazioSemResposta.texto: No topic is waiting for its first reply.

vazioFiltro.texto: Remove the filter to see the other conversations.

lista.soMembros: In this community only members read the conversations.

topico.historicoNota: The original text and every edit stay in plain sight.
topico.trancadoTexto: Whoever looks after the community locked this conversation. You can read it, but only the moderators reply.
topico.removidoTexto: Whoever looks after the community hid the conversation. The public log shows why.
topico.editarAviso: You can edit up to 30 minutes after posting, at most 5 times. Readers see the edited badge and every version.
topico.limiteEdicoes: This topic was already edited 5 times.
topico.apagarTexto: It leaves the community, along with its replies. Whoever writes can always delete what they wrote.

enquete.secreto: The vote is secret and can't be changed. The network only counts, it doesn't keep who voted for what.
enquete.soMembro: Only members vote, and after 1 hour in the community.

vazio.texto: The first reply pulls the thread.

respostas.marcar: Mark as the one that solved it
respostas.apagarTexto: It leaves the thread. Whoever writes can always delete what they wrote.
respostas.fundaDica: This is a second-level reply. Yours goes to the reply above and quotes this one.
respostas.pedidoAntes: Your request to join hasn't been approved yet.
respostas.carenciaTexto: You just joined. Replies open up 10 minutes after joining.

carenciaFalta.um: You joined a moment ago: replies open in 1 minute.
carenciaFalta.outros: You joined a moment ago: replies open in {n} minutes.

gestao.removerTexto: The content leaves every read and the reason goes to the public log. The author can appeal within 14 days.
gestao.moverTexto: You can only move to a community where you are also a moderator or owner. The topic's address doesn't change.
gestao.moverPublico: Careful: this topic leaves a closed community and becomes public at the destination. Only the origin's owner can do this.
gestao.moverSemOpcao: You don't moderate another community to move it to.

denuncia.texto: The report is anonymous: the network keeps only the reason, and the community's moderators see reasons and totals, never who reported. It removes nothing on its own: a moderator decides.
denuncia.enviada: Report received. Thanks for letting us know. You don't need to do anything else.

socModeracao.sub: Who looks after {nome}. Everything the moderators do with a reason goes to the public log, showing only the role of whoever acted.

soEquipe.titulo: This area is for the moderators
soEquipe.texto: Only the owner and whoever they promoted to moderator get in here.

fila.intro: The queue only sorts. No number of reports hides or removes content: a moderator decides. And the queue never shows who reported.

vazio.texto: No reports waiting. A good sign, or nobody noticed yet.

fila.pesoAjuda: The weight counts different reporters with accounts at least 7 days old. It only sorts the queue.
fila.semAcao: Doing nothing leaves the content up. The report stays in the queue.
fila.dispensarTexto: The report leaves the queue, the content stays up and nothing is deleted. The public log records that the report was dismissed, without saying who reported it. If someone else reports it again, the case comes back to the queue.
fila.dispensarNota: Dismissing takes the case out of the queue and leaves the content up. It stays in the public log, without saying who reported it. If someone else reports it again, the case comes back.

vazio.texto: When a rover asks to join, it shows up here for you to approve or decline.
Invite a rover from the members tab or from the community page.

membros.expulsarTexto: They leave the community and can come back, if it is open. The removal goes to the public log with the reason, without your name.
membros.banirTexto: They leave, can't come back and can't write anymore. The ban goes to the public log with the reason, and they can appeal within 14 days.

vazio.texto: When someone is banned, the reason and the appeal show up here.

apelacoes.intro: Only the owner decides appeals of moderators' decisions. When the owner acted, the network's administration decides.

vazio.texto: When a rover appeals a moderator's decision, it shows up here.

apelacoes.conteudoVazio: No retained content (the 30-day period passed, or it is a ban case).
apelacoes.manterTexto: Nothing changes and the case closes.
apelacoes.reverterTexto: The content shows up again, or the ban is lifted. The rover doesn't return as a member: they have to join again.

registro.sub: Every removal, expulsion and ban in this community stays here, with the reason and the role of whoever acted. Never the removed text and never the moderator's name.

vazio.texto: This community hasn't removed, expelled or banned anyone yet.

registro.fechadaNota: This community's log is only read by members.
